# ffxf_firewall_member (Resource)

Attaches one firewall to one virtual machine. Up to five firewalls can be attached to a machine.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `firewall_id` (Number)
- `vm_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String)
- `status` (String) Application status: applied, pending, or error.
